label: Bible Study
prompt: For my _____ are not your thoughts, neither are your ways my ways, saith the LORD.
verse: For my thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways my ways, saith the LORD.
note: God's ways and ours don't run on the same map — and the next verse says how far apart they are.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And, behold, I am with thee, and will _____ thee in all places whither thou goest, and will bring thee again into this land; for I will not leave thee, until I have done that which I have spoken to thee of.
verse: And, behold, I am with thee, and will keep thee in all places whither thou goest, and will bring thee again into this land; for I will not leave thee, until I have done that which I have spoken to thee of.
note: Jacob is on the run from Esau, sleeping on a stone — and God promises to keep him everywhere he goes.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Neither do men light a candle, and put it under a _____, but on a candlestick; and it giveth light unto all that are in the house.
verse: Neither do men light a candle, and put it under a bushel, but on a candlestick; and it giveth light unto all that are in the house.
note: A bushel was a grain-measuring basket — the one place you definitely shouldn't hide a lit candle.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And the king said unto Araunah, Nay; but I will surely buy it of thee at a price: neither will I offer burnt offerings unto the LORD my God of that which doth _____ me nothing. So David bought the threshingfloor and the oxen for fifty shekels of silver.
verse: And the king said unto Araunah, Nay; but I will surely buy it of thee at a price: neither will I offer burnt offerings unto the LORD my God of that which doth cost me nothing. So David bought the threshingfloor and the oxen for fifty shekels of silver.
note: David refused a free threshing floor for his sacrifice — the same site where Solomon would later build the temple.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against _____, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places.
verse: For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places.
note: The real fight isn't flesh and blood but 'principalities' and powers — spiritual-warfare sermons start here.
